title: Towards Uncovering How Large Language Model Works: An Explainability Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring and comparing bias scores of attention heads in pre-trained LLMs, specifically by tracking changes in attention scores between biased and regular heads to identify and mask gender-biased components.
Utilizing probing-based bias measurements and prompt engineering with carefully designed prompts to capture and evaluate recognized stereotypes and biases.

Using representation engineering to analyze hidden representations, specifically by decomposing representation vectors within MLPs using singular value decomposition (SVD) to pinpoint and mitigate dimensions contributing to toxicity.
